sources.title: Learning to match, reconstruct, and understand the 3D world to bridge ...
sources.snippet: Matchlab is a research group focused on computer vision and machine learning, with the goal to develop algorithms to match, reconstruct, and understand the visual world. We tackle challenges in monocular/stereo depth estimation, novel view synthesis, and open-world 3D perception.

sources.title: Match Lab - Grand Slam Statistics | DB4Tennis
sources.snippet: Simulate Grand Slam match outcomes with DB4Tennis Match Lab. Pick two players, choose a surface, and get AI-powered win probability predictions based on Elo ratings, surface form, and head-to-head records.
